selection_query:
SELECT s.rowid AS app_rowid,
       s.md5 AS song_md5,
       s.sha256,
       s.path,
       s.charthash,
       s.level,
       s.difficulty,
       s.maxbpm,
       s.minbpm,
       s.length,
       s.mode,
       s.judge,
       s.feature,
       s.notes,
       i.n,
       i.ln,
       i.s,
       i.ls,
       i.total,
       i.density,
       i.peakdensity,
       i.enddensity,
       i.mainbpm,
       i.distribution,
       i.speedchange,
       i.lanenotes
FROM song s
JOIN si.information i ON i.sha256 = s.sha256
WHERE lower(s.path) glob '*.bmson'
  AND (s.feature & 4) = 0
  AND s.sha256 <> ''
  AND s.charthash <> ''
ORDER BY s.sha256;
